shortDescription: Module for setup of Gslb Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: async_interval
options.description: Frequency with which messages are propagated to vs mgr. Value of 0 disables async behavior and rpc are sent inline. Allowed values are 0-5. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: auto_tune_send_interval
options.description: Automatically set the send interval value based on the load. Field introduced in 30.2.5, 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: avi_patch_path
options.description: Patch path to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_patch_value
options.description: Patch value to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: clear_on_max_retries
options.description: Max retries after which the remote site is treated as a fresh start. In fresh start all the configs are downloaded. Allowed values are 1-1024. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: client_ip_addr_group
options.description: Group to specify if the client ip addresses are public or private. Field introduced in 17.1.2. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: configpb_attributes
options.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: dns_configs
options.description: Sub domain configuration for the gslb. Gslb services fqdn must be a match one of these subdomains. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: enable_config_by_members
options.description: Allows enable/disable of gslbservice pool groups and pool members from the gslb follower members. Field introduced in 20.1.5. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: error_resync_interval
options.description: Frequency with which errored messages are resynced to follower sites. Value of 0 disables resync behavior. Allowed values are 60-3600. Special values are 0 - disable. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 300.

options.name: fileobject_max_file_versions
options.description: This is the max number of file versions that will be retained for a file referenced by the federated fileobject. Subsequent uploads of file will result in the file rotation of the older version and the latest version retained. Example  when a file upload is done for the first time, there will be a v1 version. Subsequent uploads will get mapped to v1, v2 and v3 versions. On the fourth upload of the file, the v1 will be file rotated and v2, v3 and v4 will be retained. Allowed values are 1-5. Field

options.name: gs_member_fqdn_resolution_on_se
options.displayName: Gs Member Fqdn Resolution On Se
options.description: If this knob is enabled, gslb service member fqdn will be resolved by the service engines hosting the gslb service. Each service engine will resolve and consume the resolved ip addresses locally. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as False.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field indicates that this object is replicated across gslb federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: leader_change_info
options.description: This field has leader change configuration info including mode, leader designate sites and other configurations for auto leader change like max short probe failures. Field introduced in 31.2.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: leader_cluster_uuid
options.description: Mark this site as leader of gslb configuration. This site is the one among the avi sites. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: maintenance_mode
options.description: This field disables the configuration operations on the leader for all federated objects. Cud operations on gslb, gslbservice, gslbgeodbprofile and other federated objects will be rejected. The rest-api disabling helps in upgrade scenarios where we dont want configuration sync operations to the gslb member when the member is being upgraded. This configuration programmatically blocks the leader from accepting new gslb configuration when member sites are undergoing upgrade. Field introduced in 17.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the gslb object. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: patch_level
options.description: Patch level to use when using patch.

options.name: send_interval
options.description: Frequency with which group members communicate. Allowed values are 1-3600. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 15.

options.name: send_interval_prior_to_maintenance_mode
options.displayName: Send Interval Prior To Maintenance Mode
options.description: The user can specify a send-interval while entering maintenance mode. The validity of this maintenance send-interval is only during maintenance mode. When the user leaves maintenance mode, the original send-interval is reinstated. This internal variable is used to store the original send-interval. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interprete

options.name: short_probe_interval
options.description: Wait time between two consecutive short probe health checks. Allowed values are 1-3600. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Unit is sec. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 30.

options.name: sites
options.description: Select avi site member belonging to this gslb. Minimum of 1 items required. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: tenant_scoped
options.description: This field indicates tenant visibility for gs pool member selection across the gslb federated objects.tenant scope can be set only during the gslb create and cannot be changed once it is set. Field introduced in 18.2.12,20.1.4. Allowed with any value in enterprise, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: third_party_sites
options.description: Third party site member belonging to this gslb. Field introduced in 17.1.1. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the gslb object. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition.

options.name: view_id
options.description: The view-id is used in change-leader mode to differentiate partitioned groups while they have the same gslb namespace. Each partitioned group will be able to operate independently by using the view-id. Allowed with any value in enterprise, essentials, basic, enterprise with cloud services edition. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.
